function.name: simulate_high_j_1d
function.description: High-J effective S=1 triplet: stationary field spectrum without kinetic relaxation; returns reusable spin_model.

field_axis.description: Strictly increasing axis in tesla; endpoints are included.

population_basis.description: Basis of the ordered initial populations only; T1 always eigen, sublevel loss always xyz.

population_mode.description: notebook: high-J 1D minmax, high-J 2D raw, moderate-J max.

normalization.description: Optional whole-spectrum amplitude normalization preserving E/A signs.

name.description: Optional artifact name prefix: letters, digits, _ or -.

include_data.description: Inline axes and spectrum only for <=10000 samples; artifacts always contain all samples.

lorentz.description: Lorentzian FWHM in tesla; at least one linewidth must be positive.

ham_strain.description: Optional residual Gaussian FWHM in Hz: scalar or three principal widths; default 0.

g.description: Dimensionless g factor or three principal values for effective S=1.

mesh.description: One resolution for both powder meshes: (mesh, mesh).

frame.description: Common molecular tensor frame, ZYZ Euler angles in radians; default [0,0,0].

p_x.description: Relative molecular XYZ (or singlet) weight, not a unit-sum probability.

p_y.description: Relative molecular XYZ (or singlet) weight, not a unit-sum probability.

p_z.description: Relative molecular XYZ (or singlet) weight, not a unit-sum probability.

function.name: simulate_high_j_2d
function.description: High-J effective S=1 triplet: time-field map varying context with a fixed spin_model from 1D/full.

field_axis.description: Strictly increasing axis in tesla; endpoints are included.

population_basis.description: Basis of the ordered initial populations only; T1 always eigen, sublevel loss always xyz.

population_mode.description: notebook: high-J 1D minmax, high-J 2D raw, moderate-J max.

normalization.description: Optional whole-spectrum amplitude normalization preserving E/A signs.

name.description: Optional artifact name prefix: letters, digits, _ or -.

include_data.description: Inline axes and spectrum only for <=10000 samples; artifacts always contain all samples.

lorentz.description: Lorentzian FWHM in tesla; at least one linewidth must be positive.

ham_strain.description: Optional residual Gaussian FWHM in Hz: scalar or three principal widths; default 0.

g.description: Dimensionless g factor or three principal values for effective S=1.

mesh.description: One resolution for both powder meshes: (mesh, mesh).

frame.description: Common molecular tensor frame, ZYZ Euler angles in radians; default [0,0,0].

device.description: Optional execution-device override for a saved spin_model.

time_axis.description: Strictly increasing axis in seconds since preparation (t=0); endpoints are included.

start.description: First point in seconds since preparation (t=0)

stop.description: Last point in seconds since preparation (t=0)

p_x.description: Relative molecular XYZ (or singlet) weight, not a unit-sum probability.

p_y.description: Relative molecular XYZ (or singlet) weight, not a unit-sum probability.

p_z.description: Relative molecular XYZ (or singlet) weight, not a unit-sum probability.

tau_intra.description: T1 parameter: neighboring energy-ordered eigenstate links; lifetime in microseconds, rate=1e6/tau s^-1. null disables this rate.

tau_out_x.description: Loss from molecular sublevel x; lifetime in microseconds, rate=1e6/tau s^-1. null disables this rate.

tau_out_y.description: Loss from molecular sublevel y; lifetime in microseconds, rate=1e6/tau s^-1. null disables this rate.

tau_out_z.description: Loss from molecular sublevel z; lifetime in microseconds, rate=1e6/tau s^-1. null disables this rate.

rise_time_us.description: Optional positive rise time in us: S(B,t)-S(B,0)*exp(-t/T); omit for raw MaRS kinetics.

function.name: simulate_moderate_j_1d
function.description: Moderate-J two S=1/2 radical pair: stationary field spectrum without kinetic relaxation; returns reusable spin_model.

J.description: Exchange in Hz, convention +J*S1 dot S2; negative J is allowed.

mesh.description: One resolution for both powder meshes: (mesh, mesh).

frame.description: Common molecular tensor frame, ZYZ Euler angles in radians; default [0,0,0].
